about: Vectors for web/player/src/remote-sdp.ts filterRemoteSdp(sdp, mode) (remoteCandidates, nutflix-pear ADR 0023 rule 5). A case's SDP is head + in + tail, each line ended by CRLF, and it must come out as head + out + tail the same way; or in_raw must come out as out_raw, byte for byte. mode is 'global' unless given. Addresses are examples only.

o=- 4611731400430051336 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0
a=extmap-allow-mixed
a=msid-semantic: WMS
m=application 9 UDP/DTLS/SCTP webrtc-datachannel
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=ice-ufrag:Vx9k
